author: Chris Schommer
title: Anthony Kay cruises on mound in no-decision
desc: Anthony Kay allowed three hits and two walks while striking out eight over six scoreless innings in Monday's win over the Guardians.
impact: Kay continues a strong stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in six of his last eight trips to the mound. The left-hander has turned into one of the more stable arms in the White Sox rotation for manager Will Venable, posting a 4.24 ERA and 1.39 WHIP with a 6-2 record and 2.1 K/BB ratio through 16 appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Burch Smith (shoulder) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Tigers transferred RHP Burch Smith from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens a spot on the Tigers 40-man roster. He will be sidelined through the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jeremy Pena (hamstring) to go through full workout Tuesday
desc: Jeremy Pena will go through a full pregame workout before Tuesday's game against the Blue Jays.
impact: Pena is out of Tuesday's lineup due to a hamstring cramp. He could be available off the bench if he is cleared.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connor Joe optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Mariners optioned Connor Joe to Triple-A Tacoma.
impact: Joe returns to Triple-A with Randy Arozarena activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Arozarena (hamstring) activated from IL
desc: The Mariners activated Randy Arozarena from the injured list.
impact: Arozarena makes a quick return from a stint on the injured list with a hamstring injury. Connor Joe was optioned to Triple-A as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ricky Tiedemann (elbow) to make rehab appearance Tuesday
desc: Ricky Tiedemann will make an appearance on his rehab assignment on Wednesday.
impact: Tiedemann will pitch in relief. The Blue Jays are continuing to slowly build him back.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ernie Clement (hip) not in lineup Tuesday
desc: Ernie Clement is not in the Blue Jays lineup on Tuesday against the Astros.
impact: Clement is dealing with an injured hip. He is day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Koenig (elbow) to make rehab appearance Wednesday
desc: Jared Koenig's next rehab outing is slated for Wednesday.
impact: Koenig continues on his rehab assignment as he works his way back from an elbow injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: DL Hall (pec) getting re-evaluated Tuesday
desc: DL Hall is getting re-evaluated on Tuesday.
impact: If all goes well, Hall will be cleared to resume throwing.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Lockridge (knee) expected to return late July
desc: Brandon Lockridge's return has been bumped back to late July.
impact: Lockridge underwent imaging that revealed a chondral flap in his right patella.

author: Chase Davis
title: Shohei Ohtani goes deep again as Dodgers squeak past Twins
desc: Shohei Ohtani went 1-for-4 in a win over the Twins with a home run, a run scored and one RBI.
impact: After Monday's win, Ohtani is batting .296 with 17 home runs, 44 RBI, 54 runs scored and six stolen bases across 71 games. He's homered five times in his last ten games and continues to raise his season line.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Coleman Crow (flexor strain) throws bullpen Tuesday
desc: Coleman Crow threw a bullpen on Tuesday.
impact: Crow landed on the injured list earlier in June. He'll likely require at least one more bullpen before he gets cleared to face live hitters.

author: Chase Davis
title: Freddie Freeman goes deep to push Dodgers past Twins
desc: Freddie Freeman went 1-for-4 in win over the Twins with a home run, a run scored and an RBI while striking out twice.
impact: After Monday's win, Freeman is slashing .273/.363/.476 across 76 games with 13 home runs, 41 RBI, 43 runs scored and two stolen bases.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Quinn Priester (shoulder) undergoes surgery Monday
desc: Quinn Priester underwent surgery on Monday.
impact: Priester will miss the rest of this season. He'll rehab to make a full recovery heading into spring training next year.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Henderson (back) aiming for rehab start Sunday
desc: Logan Henderson is aiming to begin a rehab assignment on Sunday.
impact: Henderson was scheduled to throw live batting practice on Tuesday. He'll figure to require multiple outings on a rehab assignment before he is activated.
